questions.prompt: What is the lowest AFROTC cadet rank?
questions.explanation: Cadet ranks, lowest to highest: Cadet Fourth Class, Cadet Third Class, Cadet Second Lieutenant, Cadet First Lieutenant, Cadet Captain, Cadet Major, Cadet Lieutenant Colonel, Cadet Colonel.

questions.prompt: Which cadet rank comes directly after Cadet Third Class?
questions.explanation: Cadet Third Class is followed by Cadet Second Lieutenant. Order: Cadet Fourth Class, Cadet Third Class, Cadet Second Lieutenant, Cadet First Lieutenant, Cadet Captain, Cadet Major, Cadet Lieutenant Colonel, Cadet Colonel.

questions.prompt: What is the highest AFROTC cadet rank?
questions.explanation: Cadet Colonel is the highest. Order: Cadet Fourth Class, Cadet Third Class, Cadet Second Lieutenant, Cadet First Lieutenant, Cadet Captain, Cadet Major, Cadet Lieutenant Colonel, Cadet Colonel.

questions.prompt: Which cadet rank comes directly after Cadet Captain?
questions.explanation: Cadet Captain is followed by Cadet Major, then Cadet Lieutenant Colonel and Cadet Colonel.

questions.prompt: On cadet shoulder boards, how are Cadet Fourth Class and Cadet Third Class marked?
questions.explanation: Cadet Fourth and Third Class wear diagonal stripes. Cadet officer ranks wear horizontal stripes, more stripes for higher rank.
Officer ranks: O1 Second Lieutenant, O2 First Lieutenant, O3 Captain, O4 Major, O5 Lieutenant Colonel, O6 Colonel, O7 Brigadier General, O8 Major General, O9 Lieutenant General, O10 General.
O-5 is Lieutenant Colonel (Lt Col), who wears a silver oak leaf.
O-7 is Brigadier General (Brig Gen), one star.
O-9 is Lieutenant General (Lt Gen), three stars. O-8 Major General has two.

questions.prompt: Which officer rank wears a gold oak leaf?
questions.explanation: Major (O-4) wears a gold oak leaf; Lieutenant Colonel (O-5) wears a silver one.
